test_title: PYST 39: RRB Group D - GA (Held On: 14 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What is the aim of the Digital Twin with AI-Driven Insights initiative showcased at India Mobile Congress 2025?

options.text: To create gaming systems for telecom users
To produce sensors for consumer devices
To design marketing tools for phone makers

solution:
The correct answer is __**To plan and manage infrastructure**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Digital Twin with AI-Driven Insights** initiative is a sophisticated technological framework designed to create high-fidelity **virtual replicas** of physical assets, systems, or processes to **plan and manage infrastructure** effectively.
 
• At the **India Mobile Congress 2025**, this initiative highlights the integration of **Artificial Intelligence (AI)** and **Internet of Things (IoT)** to provide real-time monitoring and predictive analytics for large-scale projects.
 
• It allows urban planners and engineers to simulate various environmental and operational conditions, helping to optimize the layout of **telecom towers**, **power grids**, and **transportation networks** before physical construction begins. ***Hence, the objective is to plan and manage infrastructure.***
 
• By leveraging **AI-driven insights**, the system can identify potential bottlenecks or structural weaknesses in **utility networks**, thereby enhancing the **resilience** and **sustainability** of national infrastructure.
 
• This initiative is central to the development of **Smart Cities** in **India**, providing a data-centric approach to managing resources and reducing **operational costs** through automated decision-making processes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Digital Twin Technology:**
 
 
• A **Digital Twin** is a dynamic virtual model that stays linked to its physical counterpart through **sensors** and **real-time data** feeds.
 
• It is widely used in **Industry 4.0**, **aerospace**, and **automotive sectors** for performance testing and troubleshooting without risking physical hardware.
 
• In the context of **telecommunications**, it helps in mapping **signal coverage** and managing the deployment of **5G and 6G small cells** in dense urban areas.
 
 
 
• **India Mobile Congress (IMC):**
 
 
• **IMC** is the largest **digital technology forum** in **Asia**, jointly organized by the **Department of Telecommunications (DoT)** and the **Cellular Operators Association of India (COAI)**.
 
• The event serves as a platform for showcasing innovations in **6G**, **Artificial Intelligence**, **Cloud Computing**, and **Cybersecurity**.
 
• The **2025 edition** focuses on the theme of "Global Digital Innovation," emphasizing **India's** role as a global leader in **digital transformation**.
 
 
 
• **Role of AI in Infrastructure:**
 
 
• **AI algorithms** process massive datasets generated by infrastructure sensors to perform **predictive maintenance**, identifying faults before they lead to service outages.
 
• This technology is vital for **disaster management**, as it can simulate the impact of **floods** or **earthquakes** on the physical infrastructure of a city.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Strategic Applications:**
 
 
• **Network Optimization**: Telecom operators use digital twins to minimize **latency** and maximize **bandwidth** efficiency across **broadband networks**.
 
• **Cost Reduction**: By identifying inefficiencies in the planning stage, the government and private entities can save billions in **capital expenditure (CAPEX)** and **operational expenditure (OPEX)**.
 
• **Data Sovereignty**: As these twins handle sensitive geographical and structural data, the initiative also emphasizes **data security** and compliance with **India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act (2023)**.
 
 
</ul
